definitions.full: H5105. neharah נְהָרָה noun feminine light, daylight (as Aramaic נְהוֺרָא masculine); — נ עָלָיו ׳וְאַלתּֿוֺפַע Job 3:4 (opposed to חשֶׁךְ ).
